## Problem

What problem would this solve? What are you trying to do today that Tollwise does not support?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you would like Tollwise to do. Be as concrete as you can.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why they fall short.

## Additional context

Anything else that would help evaluate this: links, examples from other tools, or how it fits with [drop-in compatibility](https://github.com/nunomarques97/tollwise/blob/main/README.md) and the routing model.
